name: Google
description: Google Workspace integration for Sheets, Drive, and Gmail

client_id.title: OAuth Client ID
client_id.description: Your Google OAuth 2.0 Client ID from Google Cloud Console

access_token.title: Access Token
access_token.description: OAuth access token (populated automatically after authorization)

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token (populated automatically after authorization)

google_sheets_get_values.description: Read rows from a Google Sheets spreadsheet. Returns values from a specified range.

spreadsheet_id.title: Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheet_id.description: The ID of the spreadsheet (from the URL: docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/{ID}/edit)

range.title: Range
range.description: The A1 notation of the range to read (e.g., 'Sheet1!A1:D10' or 'A1:D10')

majorDimension.title: Major Dimension
majorDimension.description: How to interpret the returned values

valueRenderOption.title: Value Render Option
valueRenderOption.description: How values should be rendered in the output

dateTimeRenderOption.title: Date/Time Render Option
dateTimeRenderOption.description: How dates and times should be rendered

range.description: The range of cells in A1 notation

majorDimension.description: The major dimension of the values

google_sheets_append_values.description: Append rows to a Google Sheets spreadsheet. Adds data after the last row with content.

range.title: Range
range.description: The A1 notation of the range to append to (e.g., 'Sheet1!A:D')

values.title: Rows
values.description: The rows to append. Each row is an array of cell values.

valueInputOption.title: Value Input Option
valueInputOption.description: How the input data should be interpreted

insertDataOption.title: Insert Data Option
insertDataOption.description: How the input data should be inserted

includeValuesInResponse.title: Include Values in Response
includeValuesInResponse.description: Return the values that were appended

google_sheets_update_values.description: Update existing rows in a Google Sheets spreadsheet. Overwrites data in the specified range.

range.title: Range
range.description: The A1 notation of the range to update (e.g., 'Sheet1!A2:D5')

values.title: Rows
values.description: The rows to write. Each row is an array of cell values.

valueInputOption.title: Value Input Option
valueInputOption.description: How the input data should be interpreted

includeValuesInResponse.title: Include Values in Response
includeValuesInResponse.description: Return the values that were written

google_sheets_clear_values.description: Clear values from a range in a Google Sheets spreadsheet. Removes data but keeps formatting.

range.title: Range
range.description: The A1 notation of the range to clear (e.g., 'Sheet1!A2:D10')

google_sheets_get_spreadsheet.description: Get metadata about a Google Sheets spreadsheet, including sheet names and properties.

includeGridData.title: Include Grid Data
includeGridData.description: Include cell data in the response (can be slow for large sheets)

google_drive_list_files.description: List files and folders in Google Drive. Supports filtering by folder, name, and type.

q.title: Query
q.description: Search query (e.g., "'folderId' in parents" or "name contains 'report'")

pageSize.title: Page Size
pageSize.description: Maximum number of files to return (1-1000)

pageToken.title: Page Token
pageToken.description: Token for fetching the next page of results

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Fields to include in the response
fields.default: nextPageToken, files(id, name, mimeType, size, createdTime, modifiedTime, webViewLink)

google_drive_upload_file.description: Upload a file to Google Drive. Supports creating new files or updating existing ones.

content.title: Content
content.description: File content (text or base64 encoded for binary)

parents.title: Parent Folders
parents.description: Folder IDs to upload to (leave empty for root)

mimeType.title: MIME Type
mimeType.description: File MIME type (auto-detected if not specified)

google_drive_download_file.description: Download a file from Google Drive. Returns file content or export for Google Docs formats.

file_id.title: File ID
file_id.description: The ID of the file to download

acknowledgeAbuse.title: Acknowledge Abuse Warning
acknowledgeAbuse.description: Acknowledge download of potentially abusive files

google_drive_get_file.description: Get metadata about a file in Google Drive without downloading its content.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Fields to include in the response
fields.default: id, name, mimeType, size, createdTime, modifiedTime, webViewLink, webContentLink, parents

gmail_send_message.description: Send an email via Gmail. Supports plain text and HTML content with attachments.

html.title: HTML Body
html.description: HTML email body (optional, overrides plain text)

from.title: From
from.description: Sender address; defaults to the authorized account

example_parameters.subject: Workflow Complete
example_parameters.body: Your workflow has finished processing successfully.

gmail_list_messages.description: List emails in Gmail inbox. Supports filtering by labels, search query, and pagination.

labelIds.title: Label IDs
labelIds.description: Only return messages with these labels

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of messages to return (1-500)

pageToken.title: Page Token
pageToken.description: Token for fetching the next page of results

includeSpamTrash.title: Include Spam/Trash
includeSpamTrash.description: Include messages from spam and trash

gmail_get_message.description: Get the full content of an email by its ID. Returns headers, body, and attachments.

message_id.title: Message ID
message_id.description: The ID of the email message

metadataHeaders.title: Metadata Headers
metadataHeaders.description: Headers to include when format is 'metadata'

google_calendar_list_events.description: List events from a Google Calendar. Supports filtering by time range and search query.

calendar_id.title: Calendar ID
calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier. Use 'primary' for the primary calendar.

timeMin.title: Time Min
timeMin.description: Lower bound for event start time (ISO 8601 format, e.g., 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z)

timeMax.title: Time Max
timeMax.description: Upper bound for event start time (ISO 8601 format)

q.title: Search Query
q.description: Free text search terms to find events

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of events to return

orderBy.title: Order By
orderBy.description: Order of events in the result

singleEvents.title: Expand Recurring Events
singleEvents.description: Whether to expand recurring events into instances

google_calendar_get_event.description: Get details of a specific calendar event.

google_calendar_create_event.description: Create a new calendar event with details like title, time, attendees, and location.

requestId.title: Request ID
requestId.description: Unique ID for the conference request

google_calendar_quick_add.description: Create an event from a simple text string (e.g., 'Meeting with John tomorrow at 3pm').

text.title: Event Text
text.description: Natural language event description (e.g., 'Lunch meeting tomorrow at 12pm' or 'Team sync on Friday at 2pm for 1 hour')

example_parameters.text: Coffee with Sarah on Monday at 3pm
